int_name: E WILLOW GROVE AVE & WINSTON RD

result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, but lacks visible sidewalks and pedestrian signals, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved surfaces. Large trees at the corners and faded markings create potential safety issues by reducing visibility and clarity of the pedestrian space.

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalks
hazards.description: No paved walkways are visible at the intersection corners, requiring pedestrians to walk on grass or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the foreground and mid-ground

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large trees at the corners may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on all sides of the intersection to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Refresh Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the continental crosswalks with high-visibility, durable thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Install Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Add ADA-compliant curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility for all users.

result.summary: A residential intersection featuring sidewalks and marked crosswalks on multiple legs. The primary safety concern is the tall hedge at the corner which severely limits visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side corner of the intersection

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove tall vegetation at the corner to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a wide, marked crosswalk that is significantly faded. While a sidewalk is present on the left, the lack of traffic control and sight line obstructions from parked vehicles create potential risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street near the crosswalk

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk repainting
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection, which improves sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian crossing signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' warning signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked ladder-style crosswalks and sidewalks. Safety is supported by basic infrastructure, but visibility is limited by corner vegetation and the pavement is in fair to poor condition.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Large trees and bushes on the corner lots may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking in the roadway surface could pose a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
